scope: Independent native-data numerical checks and visual review of corrected reporting candidates; no scientific sampling or training.

numerical_checks.source_evidence: All 30 native result.pkl files through load_runs; 140 rows and five checkpoints per run validated. Fake axis captured plot arrays; no plots generated by this check.

findings: Training action-violation curves no longer contain artificial evaluation-iteration zero spikes.
Undefined B_env windows appear as gaps with bottom-axis crosses; isolated supported estimates remain visible as points and SD whiskers.
The Phase-4 row explicitly says batch size (projection skipped).
BATCH4 axes distinguish iteration from training environment steps in millions.
Legends, labels and curves are readable when enlarged; the broad eight-column layout remains dense at small inline size.
limitations: Sample SD is computed across only three seeds; many B_env windows remain undefined.
At a nonpositive lower SD bound, only the positive upper whisker is drawn; no epsilon substitution.
These plotting corrections do not resolve the separately reported Phase-1 bootstrap uncertainty problem.

preservation: All original figures and curated outputs remain in place. Reviewer wrote only new review records and inspected root-generated candidate figures.
